id: title:Gilbert09:merge webhook files with divergent column types

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience: P1.F2.H1 adds row-level reconstruction fallback in `webhook_s3.py` to prevent ingestion failures when warehouse payloads have incompatible column types, allowing ingestion to continue rather than raising an exception.
review.reason: P1.F2.H1 implements a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it replaces a failure mode (exception on incompatible column types) with a fallback reconstruction strategy. This demonstrates a reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion without requiring unverified adoption or incident avoidance. P1.F1.H1 is a test file and is not scored.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies solely on the implementation change; no test results or runtime behavior are supplied to verify the fallback actually executes or its performance. The benefit is inferred from the code change, not observed outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F2.H1 shows a substantive implementation change in webhook_s3.py. P1.F1.H1 is a test file. The score depends on P1.F2.H1. P1.F1.H1 is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback row-level reconstruction when pa.concat_tables fails due to incompatible column types.
observations.code_quote: rows = [row for table in tables for row in table.to_pylist()]
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to continue when payload fields have mixed types across files, rather than failing or raising an exception.
